$comment: Ground-truth fixtures from sub-phase 0.7. Every entry carries a `license`, which sub-phase 1.1 will make a CI-enforced requirement for the whole corpus; this directory is written to that rule already. Nothing here is derived from a third-party font or document: experiment A commits measurements of Microsoft fonts, never their bytes.

entries.description: 214 solid-fill swatches exercising every DrawingML colour transform, with the RGB PowerPoint painted for each. The deck was generated by tools/ground-truth/build-swatch-deck.ts and contains no third-party content.
entries.regenerate: node tools/ground-truth/build-swatch-deck.ts <dir> && <open in PowerPoint, export> && node tools/ground-truth/analyse-swatches.ts <dir> --fixture corpus/ground-truth/color-transforms.json

entries.description: The EOT header of all 76 ppt/fonts/*.fntdata parts across four decks PowerPoint saved, with subsetting on and off. Header fields only: no font data, no glyph outlines, nothing that is Microsoft's to license. The decks themselves are NOT committed, because they contain Microsoft's fonts.

A synthetic TrueType font whose eight letters are solid bars of increasing height, so a rendering of ABCDEFGH is a staircase no substitute font can imitate. Accepted and rendered exactly by Chromium's OTS sanitiser and by Windows GDI+. Family name 'ProbeAlpha' exists nowhere, which is what makes it a valid test of whether an embedded font was used.
probe.ttf wrapped in an uncompressed EOT version 0x00010000, charset 1, names not NUL-terminated. PowerPoint 365 does not render it.

The probe font wrapped in an uncompressed EOT version 0x00020002 with NUL-terminated FamilyName and StyleName, charset 0, and the full v2.2 tail - byte-for-byte the header shape PowerPoint itself writes, differing only in that the payload is not compressed. PowerPoint 365 does not render it either, which is the core of experiment B's finding. Family name is 'ProbeCharlie'.
